readOnlySql: WITH per_person AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS person,COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT json_build_object('maxOrders',MAX(cnt),'peopleAboveBoundary',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cnt>6),'peopleAtBoundary',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE cnt=6),'nullIdentityGroups',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE person IS NULL),'selectedCounts',(SELECT json_object_agg(person,cnt) FROM per_person WHERE person IN ('12f5d6e1cbf93dafd9dcc19095df0b3d','1b6c7548a2a1f9037c1fd3ddfed95f33','3e43e6105506432c953e165fb2acf44c','47c1a3033b8b77b3ab6e109eb4d5fdf3','63cfc61cee11cbe306bff5857d00bfe4','6469f99c1f9dfae7733b25662e7f1782','8d50f5eadf50201ccdcedfb9e2ac8455','ca77025e7201e3b30c44b472ff346268','dc813062e0fc23409cd255f7f53c7074','de34b16117594161a6a89c50b289d35a','f0e310a6839dce9de1638e0fe5ab282a'))) FROM per_person
